# #937 — aqmd up skips _DOCS/_handover/ and docs/sme/entries/: the .qmd/index.yml allowlist is stale

State: OPEN
Author: rodaddy

---

Filed 2026-08-27 by the #878 session-9 head (native Claude, `docs/pg-tests-session9`) at session wrap, per the handover-author drain step.

## The gap

`aqmd up` in this repo does not index `_DOCS/_handover/`, `_DOCS/_parked/`, `docs/sme/_headers/`, `docs/sme/entries/`, `scripts/done-means/fixtures/`, `scripts/test-support/`, `server/capture/`, `tests/`, and one more directory. Its own output says so on every run:

```
open-brain/.qmd/index.yml -- their files were NOT indexed by the refresh above.
    _DOCS/_handover/
    _DOCS/_parked/
    docs/sme/_headers/
    docs/sme/entries/
    scripts/done-means/fixtures/
    scripts/test-support/
    server/capture/
    tests/
    ... and 1 more
  The allowlist is a snapshot; new directories need it rebuilt:
    DEV=/Volumes/ThunderBolt/Development ONLY_REPO=open-brain REGEN=1 /Volumes/ThunderBolt/Development/_ob/bin/qmd-backfill
```

`sqlite3 .qmd/index.sqlite` shows the shape: 248 documents under those paths are in the index from an earlier full build, but the three files this session added there (the session-10 handover and two SME entries) are absent (0 rows) after two `aqmd up` runs, so the refresh skips the directories and the index only ages. The session-wrap rule ("run `aqmd up` so the session's notes are searchable by the next agent") is satisfied in form and not in effect for handovers and SME entries: `aqmd search "authorizeTierLane"` returns nothing from the session-10 handover that names it, and the 81 SME entry files are unreachable by search.

## Why it is not just fixed here

The rebuild rewrites `.qmd/index.yml`, the same tracked file whose three `models:` lines every `aqmd up` already rewrites to the fleet endpoint and which the git guard refuses agents to restore (session-9 handover, HANDED-OVER UNKNOWNS). Regenerating the allowlist is a repo config change on top of an unruled churn; both belong in one decision.

## Ask

Rico rules on `.qmd/index.yml`: commit the regenerated allowlist plus the fleet `models:` lines, or ignore the file, or something else. Then one `REGEN=1` run and a commit; a done-means check that greps `aqmd up` output for `NOT indexed` would keep it from drifting again.
